'''Pestilential Ores''' are infested versions of regular ores.

==''Generation''==
Pestilential Ore itself is generated via [[Beckon]] infestation or [[Infested Bonemeal]] on [[Remains]]. It can also be generated when Infested Bonemeal is used on regular Pestilential vanilla ores twice.

The infested versions of regular ore generate under the same circumstances for the corresponding ore block.

==''Usage''==
Pestilential Ore can be smelted to create a [[Twisted Spinal Signal]], while the other infested Ores smelt into two of their corresponding raw form. Pestilential Ores always drop one of themselves as a block and are unaffected by multipliers like Fortune.
